notes.title: 5.3 Major update, teleportation function, new spells and other important adjustm
notes.content:
1. Added transmission function, now each storage point can initiate transmission, with a fixed destination of 8 transmission points
2. Added 3 spells, obtained by defeating three bosses in the main storyline
3. The church gate has added a new BOSS, with adjusted attack methods and a more handsome wielding of knives
4. Defeating the Demon Swordsman BOSS in the later stages of the main storyline can increase basic attack power by 5 points
5. Now，When saving , both health and mana levels will be restored to full
6. The operation teaching in the opening scene can be automatically adapted, and keyboard operation teaching will appear when using the keyboard. Using the joystick will result in joystick operation teaching
7. Now you can view the operation key diagram in the menu. Select Control to see the basic operation methods of the keyboard and controller
There may be some adjustments to the scene art in the future

notes.title: 4.2 Update, adjust intensity, fix bugs
notes.content:
4.2 Update

1. Reduced the intensity of the Worship Top BOSS, providing a more concrete combat experience
2. Adjusted the attack distance of the new monster and adapted to the distance from the protagonist
3. Fix some minor bugs in certain scenarios



3.26 update, new modes, new maps, new bosses, new features

1. Further optimized the feel, making it more suitable for joystick operation
2. Added a small map function that allows you to see the explored area and the location of the text of items that have not yet been obtained. Press the keyboard M/joystick R2 to start
3. Added a new enemy with new attack methods
4. New maps have been added, using a completely new drawing method, and other maps may be used in the future
5. Added new bosses, new items and skills that can be obtained after defeating, very practical
6. Added a brand new mode, Blood Path Mode, which has twice the attack but loses 1% of health per second, providing an even more extreme survival challenge
The store industry has also changed its promotional videos

We will continue to update in the future, please rest assured that the next wave of updates will focus on map adjustments and plot expression

notes.title: 2.17 Important Update
notes.content:
1、Reduce the attack speed of enemies, decrease the number of enemies, re - configure the positions of enemies, enhance the gaming experience, and slow down the game rhythm.
2、Add save points. Now there are save points both before and after each boss fight.
3、Increase the hit - protection time to provide more room for operation.
4、Added some individual maps and adjusted the feedback and movement patterns of some enemy.

Overall, the adjusted rhythm is more relaxed, making it more suitable for playing and exploration. Meanwhile, the playability of the actions has also been enhanced.
